events.title: Discord Server!
events.summary: Hey everyone, Thank you so much for all the support on FEED IT so far. Working on the game has been a lot of fun, and I'm excited to start sharing progress updates and getting feedback from you all. I made a Discord server for anyone interested in following the game: https://discord.com/invite/MJYR3DsEG5Feel free to join if you want news about the game, want to chat, give feedback or report any issues with the demo!

events.title: Demo update #1
events.summary: Small changes and improvements.Animated mainmenuFixed discord invite linkBrightness is increasedMonster footstep sounds is decreasedCrouch set on toggleProximity chat radius increasedKnown issues:Interaction text disappears sometimes - Fix but rejoining the lobbyIf you run into any more issues, please report them in the discord so I can get them fixed!

events.title: Demo is out!
events.summary: A bit of a late announcement, but the demo is live!This is an early demo version, so a lot of things may change and there could be bugs. The goal of the demo is to let players try the gameplay loop and help improve the game before full release.Current demo Limitations: * Includes only one playable level* Limited forest variation* Limited monster variants* Limited tools and weapons* No progression or difficulty scaling I plan on updating the demo more while working on the full game so stay tuned.
